requirements.quote:
The parameter MinASOriginationIntervalTimer determines the minimum
   amount of time that must elapse between successive advertisements of
   UPDATE messages that report changes within the advertising BGP
   speaker's own autonomous systems.
requirements.condition: Successive advertisements of UPDATE messages report changes within the advertising BGP speaker's own autonomous systems.
requirements.required_behavior: Ensure that at least the minimum time determined by MinASOriginationIntervalTimer elapses between successive advertisements.
requirements.why_checkable: The interval between qualifying UPDATE advertisements can be compared with MinASOriginationIntervalTimer.
